ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, a rectangular window frame in the shape of the character "目" is made from 48 meters of wood (the crossbars EF and GH are also made of wood). Where AB $\parallel$ EF $\parallel$ GH $\parallel$ CD, to maximize the area of the window frame ABCD, what should be the length of AB?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Let the length of AB be $x$ meters, then the length of AD is $\frac{48-4x}{2}$ meters.\\
Using the formula for the area of a rectangle, we get: $S_{\text{rectangle}} = \text{AD} \cdot \text{AB} = x \cdot \frac{48-4x}{2} = -2x^2 + 24x = -2(x-6)^2 + 72$,\\
$\because 48-4x > 0$,\\
$\therefore x < 12$,\\
$\therefore 0 < x < 12$,\\
$\because -2 < 0$,\\
$\therefore$ when $x = \boxed{6}$, the area of the rectangle has its maximum value.

Using the area formula of a rectangle: S = AD \cdot AB = x \cdot (48-4x)/2 = -2x^2 + 24x = -2(x-6)^2 + 72. Since 48-4x > 0, we have x < 12, so 0 < x < 12. Because the quadratic coefficient is negative, the maximum area occurs at x = 6.
ready3_open_rewrite.final_cot:
First describe the image: In the figure there is an outer-frame rectangle ABCD, with A at the upper left corner, B at the upper right corner, C at the lower right corner, and D at the lower left corner; AB is the upper side, CD is the lower side, and AD and BC are the two vertical sides. Inside the rectangle there are two horizontal wooden strips EF and GH, respectively extending from the left side AD to the right side BC, where E and G are on the left side, and F and H are on the right side; in the figure AB, EF, GH, and CD are all horizontal and mutually parallel full-width segments.
Then reason: Let AB = x meters, AD = y meters. Because EF and GH, together with AB and CD, all span the width of the same rectangle, the lengths of the four horizontal wooden strips AB, EF, GH, and CD are all x, so the total horizontal wood is 4x. The lengths of the two vertical sides AD and BC are both y, so the total vertical wood is 2y. The total length of the wood is 48 meters, so 4x + 2y = 48, solving gives y = (48 - 4x)/2 = 24 - 2x. The area of rectangle ABCD is S = AB × AD = xy = x(24 - 2x) = -2x^2 + 24x = -2(x - 6)^2 + 72. Since this is a quadratic function opening downward, when the area is maximum, x = 6. Therefore AB should be 6 meters.
